categories.headline: Weakest area: trust signals (2/5).

findings.title: Hero CTAs are generic and compete with each other
findings.evidence: The hero has two equal white pill buttons, 'Shop' and 'Watch ▶', with no indication of what 'Shop' leads to (Pegasus Plus 2?). They sit over a busy, blurred photo near the bottom. The metadata lists many other CTAs (Shop All Sale, Shop By Sport, Shop Icons) that are not visible in this viewport.
findings.fix: Label the primary CTA with its destination ('Shop Pegasus Plus 2') and style it as the clear primary button. Make 'Watch' a secondary text or ghost button. Keep one primary action per slide.
findings.impact: Visitors decide in seconds; unclear hierarchy and actions send them to a competitor.

findings.title: Almost no trust signals above the fold
findings.evidence: The page shows no visible delivery or returns information, no payment or security cues, no ratings, and no India-specific reassurance such as COD or free shipping. The only incentive is the app-discount strip, and the utility bar is only 'Help | Sign Up | Log In' in tiny type.
findings.fix: Add a slim benefits strip with free delivery, easy returns and secure payment. Add review ratings or member perks. Make the Help link more prominent.
findings.impact: Visitors decide in seconds; unclear hierarchy and actions send them to a competitor.

findings.title: Hero text contrast, carousel controls and small utility text hurt legibility
findings.evidence: The grey subcopy 'You can't be fast on Sunday…' sits over a mottled, blurred background with only moderate contrast. The pause, prev and next controls are low-contrast grey circles in the bottom right, and the three dots are tiny. The promo line's 'Download Now' and 'T&Cs' links and the top utility links are about 11–12px.
findings.fix: Add a darker gradient scrim behind the text, or move the copy to a calmer area of the image. Enlarge the carousel controls and dots and increase their contrast. Raise the small link text to at least 12–14px with clearer link styling.
findings.impact: Visitors decide in seconds; unclear hierarchy and actions send them to a competitor.
